ExhibitionsEvents Programme
Autumn Knight: I Can't Complain
29 September – 29 November 2026
I Can’t Complain is a solo exhibition by New York-based artist Autumn Knight. Featuring a new commission alongside recent work, this is the first major presentation of her work in the UK.
ExhibitionsEvents Programme
Exhibition Preview
Autumn Knight: I Can't Complain
Mon, 28 September
ICA Members are invited to celebrate the opening of I Can't Complain alongside the artist, special guests, Patrons, and fellow Members. Enjoy a guest DJ set in the bar from 7:30pm and 2-for-1 cocktails throughout the evening.
party of one: Performance by Autumn Knight
Thu, 1 October
A newly commissioned performance lecture by Autumn Knight as part of her solo exhibition I Can't Complain, addressing the nuances and pleasures of complaint. 
party pooper 1: Performance by Autumn Knight
Mon, 12 October
The first iteration of a new live performance exploring group complaint responding to the site, environment and themes of Autumn Knight's exhibition I Can't Complain.  
party pooper 2: Performance by Autumn Knight
Thu, 15 October
The second iteration of a new performance exploring group complaint responding to the site, environment and themes of Autumn Knight's solo exhibition.
Artist’s Film Picks:
No Other Choice
Wed, 21 October
Programmed by Autumn Knight to accompany her exhibition I Can’t Complain, Park Chan-wook’s jet-black satire No Other Choice (2025) is one of three films in Knight's selection.
Artist’s Film Picks:
I Am Not Your Negro
Wed, 28 October
A documentary exploring the history of racism in the United States through James Baldwin’s unfinished manuscript Remember This House. 
Members' Curator Tour
Autumn Knight: I Can't Complain
Tue, 3 November
In a special offer to ICA Members, Exhibition Curator Andrea Nitsche-Krupp leads a behind-the-scenes curatorial tour of Autumn Knight: I Can't Complain.
party done: Performance by Samra Mayanja
Fri, 6 November
The party is over, or did it ever start? The guests arrive and the party has finished. Samra Mayanja's solo performance weaves narrative and physical responses to the exhibition space. 
Artist’s Film Picks:
Persepolis
Wed, 11 November
Based on Marjane Satrapi’s acclaimed autobiographical graphic novel, Persepolis follows her childhood during the Iranian Revolution, her teenage years in exile in Europe, and her return to Iran.
pity party: Performance by Michelangelo Miccolis and nick von kleist
Fri, 20 November
Final party and performance blend into a unique event conceptualised by Autumn Knight and performed by Michelangelo Miccolis and nick von kleist; expect drinks, music and conversation.
